title: Differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells into pancreatic duct-like organoids
protocol: Precoat the desired number of wells.
Dilute GFR-Matrigel 1:18 in DMEM/F12.
Evenly distribute 220 μL of the Matrigel solution per well of a 24-well plate.
Incubate plates for 1–2 hours at 37°C.
Remove the Matrigel solution after incubation.
Add 300 μL mTeSR1 supplemented with 10 μM Rock inhibitor Y-27632.
Remove medium from hPSC culture.
Add 500 μL PBS, gently swirl the plate, and remove PBS.
Add 300 μL TrypLE Express or TrypLE Select and incubate at 37°C until cells are detached.
Dilute dissociation reagent by adding 700 μL DMEM/F12.
Resuspend cells by carefully pipetting up and down without mechanical dissociation, then transfer cell suspension into a tube or falcon.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 4–5 min and remove supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL mTeSR1 supplemented with 10 μM Y-27632.
Count viable cells using a counting chamber and adjust cell suspension to a final concentration of 1–1.5 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Dropwise add 200 μL of the cell suspension to each precoated 24-well plate (200,000 to 300,000 cells per well).
Add cell suspension in an outer circle to the wells and perform 2–3 times 8-shaped movements followed by one sudden ↕↔ movement of the plate.
Initiate differentiation 24–48 hours after cell seeding when confluency reaches 75%–95%.
Remove mTeSR medium from hPSCs.
Add 500 μL PBS, gently swirl the plate, and remove PBS.
Add 500 μL BE1a + 100 ng/mL Activin A + 2 μM CHIR99021 (medium change at d0).
Remove medium on days 1 and 2 of differentiation.
Add 500 μL BE1a + 100 ng/mL Activin A + 5 ng/mL FGF2.
Perform quality check at day 3 using flow cytometry analysis for surface marker CXCR4 and KIT or intracellular marker staining of SOX17 and GATA6.
Remove medium from cells.
Add 500 μL BE1b + 50 ng/mL FGF10 + 0.75 μM Dorsomorphin + 3 ng/mL Wnt3a (medium change at d3, d4, and d5).
Remove medium from cells.
Add 500 μL BE3 + 50 ng/mL FGF10 + 200 nM LDN-193189 + 0.25 μM SANT-1 + 2 μM retinoic acid + 16 mM glucose (medium change at d6, d7, and d8).
Perform quality check at d9.
Remove medium from cells.
Add 500 μL BE3 + 100 ng/mL EGF + 200 nM LDN-193189 + 10 mM Nicotinamide + 330 nM Indolactam V + 16 mM glucose (medium change every day from d9 to d12).
Perform quality check at d13.
Precoat the desired number of wells for cell culture.
Evenly distribute 150 μL of undiluted GFR-Matrigel per well of a 12-well plate in continuous z-shape movements on a precooled culture plate using precooled tips.
Incubate plates at 37°C for around 30 min to 1 h.
Remove medium from d13 differentiation culture.
Add 500 μL PBS, gently swirl the plate, and remove PBS.
Add 200 μL TrypLE Express or TrypLE Select and incubate at 37°C until cells are detached.
Dilute the dissociation reagent by adding 800 μL DMEM/F12.
Resuspend cells carefully without mechanical dissociation and transfer the cell suspension into a tube or falcon.
Filter the cells through a 0.22 μm syringe filter.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 4–5 minutes and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL BE3 medium.
Count viable cells using a counting chamber.
Centrifuge the desired number of cells at 200 × g for 4–5 minutes and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in PDLO medium to a final concentration of 1.05 × 10^5 cells/mL.
Put cells on ice and add 5% GFR Matrigel to the cell suspension.
Pipette up and down.
Dropwise add 1 mL of the cell suspension to each precoated 12-well (100,000 cells per well).
Perform 2–3 times 8-shaped movements followed by one sudden vertical and horizontal movement of the plate.
Critical: Ensure homogenous coating and cell seeding is important.
Perform narrow z-formed movement to evenly distribute undiluted GFR-Matrigel.
Use precooled tips and well plates and avoid any air bubbles.
Prewarm 24-well plates for dome culture at 37°C for 10 min.
Harvest PPs for PDLO differentiation.
Centrifuge the desired number of cells at 200 × g for 4–5 min and remove the supernatant.
Put cells on ice and resuspend cells with 50 μL GFR Matrigel per 30,000 cells.
Pipet up and down and add 50 μL drops of the cell suspension per well of a 24-well plate to the uncoated but prewarmed plate (30,000 cells per well).
Incubate domes for around 10 min at 37°C to allow Matrigel solidification.
Add 500 μL PDLO medium (d13-d20) to each well.
Carefully remove the medium without mechanically disrupting the thick Matrigel layer on day 13.
Add 1 mL of PDLO medium (BE3 + 50 ng/mL EGF + 50 ng/mL FGF10 + 50 ng/mL KGF + 50 nM MSC2530818 + 10 mM Nicotinamide + 10 μM Rock inhibitor Y-27632 + 10 μM ZnSO4) to the culture.
Carefully remove the medium without mechanically disrupting the thick Matrigel layer on day 17.
Add 5% GFR Matrigel and 1 mL of PDLO medium (BE3 + 50 ng/mL EGF + 50 ng/mL FGF10 + 10 mM Nicotinamide + 10 μM ZnSO4) to the culture.
Carefully remove the medium without mechanically disrupting the thick Matrigel layer on day 20.
Add 5% GFR Matrigel and 1 mL of PDLO medium (BE3 + 50 ng/mL EGF + 50 ng/mL FGF10 + 10 mM Nicotinamide + 10 μM ZnSO4) to the culture.
Remove medium from PDLOs.
Wash PDLOs twice with 1 mL PBS.
Remove PBS.
Add 1 mL of 1 mg/mL collagenase/dispase solution and incubate at 37°C until Matrigel is mostly dissolved and PDLOs are detached (2–4 h).
Add 2 mL neutralization solution to the well, rinse carefully.
Transfer cell suspension to a 15 mL falcon and centrifuge at 200 × g for 4–5 min.
Remove supernatant from the cells in the falcon tube.
Add 5 mL PBS to the cells and centrifuge at 200 × g for 4–5 min.
If Matrigel has not been completely resolved, perform an additional PBS washing step and be careful not to disrupt the pellet.
Remove supernatant, add 0.5 mL accutase, and incubate at 37°C in the water bath for 30 min.
Mix the solution by pipetting up and down (10 × before incubation, 10 × after 15 min of incubation, and 10 × at the end of incubation).
Add 1 mL neutralization solution and centrifuge at 200 × g for 4–5 min.
Remove supernatant, resuspend cells in 1 mL BE3.
Count viable cells using a counting chamber.
Centrifuge the desired number of cells at 200 × g for 4–5 min and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend cells into PDLO medium supplemented with 10 μM Rock inhibitor Y-27632 to a final concentration of 1.05 × 10^5 cells/mL.
Put cells on ice and add 5% GFR Matrigel to the cell suspension.
Pipet up and down and dropwise add 1 mL of the cell suspension to one precoated well of the 12-well plate (100,000 cells per well).
Perform 2–3 times 8-shaped movements followed by one sudden ↕↔ movement of the plate to prevent cell aggregation in the middle of the wells.
Harvest and dissociate PDLOs to single cells.
Centrifuge 1 × 10^6 cells per mouse at 200 × g for 4–5 min and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 25 μL PDLO medium supplemented with 20 μM Rock inhibitor Y-27632.
Put cells on ice and add 25 μL undiluted GFR Matrigel to the cell suspension.
Freeze vials at -80°C for around 24 h before transferring into a liquid nitrogen tank.
Quickly defrost vials at 37°C for thawing.
Add 5 mL DMEM/F12 after defrosting and centrifuge at 200 × g for 4–5 min.
Remove supernatant.
Centrifuge the desired number of cells at 200 × g for 4–5 min.
Resuspend cells in PDLO medium supplemented with 10 μM Rock inhibitor Y-27632 to a final concentration of 2–4 × 10^5 cells/mL.
Put cells on ice and add 5% GFR Matrigel to the cell suspension.
Pipette up and down.
Add 1 mL of the cell suspension to one well of a precoated 12-well plate (200,000–400,000 cells per well).
Perform 2–3 times 8-shaped movements followed by one sudden ↕↔ movement of the plate.
Harvest and dissociate PDLOs to single cells.
Extend singularization of PDLOs with accutase to 1 hour.
Remove supernatant after accutase treatment.
Proceed with surface staining or paraformaldehyde fixation for intracellular marker staining as detailed in Breunig et al. (2021).
Recover PDLOs from the Matrigel according to step III-5a (i-iv) for RNA isolation.
Perform RNA lysis according to manufacturer’s instructions after removing supernatant.
Freeze samples after lysis or continue with RNA isolation immediately.
Isolate RNA using Gene Jet RNA Purification Kit.
Recover PDLOs from the Matrigel according to step III-5a (i-iv) for protein isolation.
Incubate the Matrigel completely dissolved in PBS for at least 4 hours.
Remove supernatant and wash with 5 ml PBS after complete dissolution of Matrigel.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 4–5 min to remove supernatant.
Add 1 ml PBS, transfer cell suspension to a 1.5-ml tube, and centrifuge again at 200 × g for 4–5 minutes.
Completely remove the final supernatant.
Freeze the dry pellet at -80°C for protein isolation or proceed directly with lysis according to downstream application guidelines.
Lysate cells with RIPA buffer for Western Blotting.
Use urea buffer for mass spectrometry as detailed in Breunig et al. (2021).
Isolate DNA from PDLOs following established protocols.
Recover PDLOs from the Matrigel.
Remove supernatant.
Wash with 5 mL PBS.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 4–5 minutes.
Perform DNA lysis according to manufacturer’s instructions.
DNA isolation using Animal Tissue Genomic DNA Purification Mini Prep Kit resulted in very good DNA yields in our hands.
No singularization of PDLOs is required for the isolation of RNA, protein, or DNA.
Remove medium from organoids.
Wash with 1 mL PBS.
Remove PBS.
Add 1 mL 4% PFA solution (100 mM sucrose) for 14–18 hours at 8°C.
Transfer organoids that have been detached by the PFA treatment to a 1.5-mL tube first.
Transfer remaining organoids in PBS by detaching them with a tip coated with 1% BSA/PBS.
Rinse the well again with PBS to transfer as many organoids as possible.
Centrifuge organoids at 3000 × g for 5 min.
Remove supernatant and add 1 mL PBS.
Repeat washing step.
Prepare 2% Agarose/PBS in a small glass bottle.
Heat water in a beaker.
Let the agarose cool down to around 60°C.
Spin down organoids at 3000 × g for 3 min.
Carefully take off half of the supernatant from samples.
Transfer organoids with a 200 μL pipet, using as little liquid as possible, to cryomolds.
Remove excess liquid with a 10 μL pipet.
Add around 100 μL agarose dropwise at opposite edges of the mold to avoid floating of organoids towards one corner.
Wait until the agarose starts to polymerize.
Fill up the mold with additional agarose.
Transfer the agarose block into a tissue cassette with filter paper when it has cooled down to 20°C–23°C.
Incubate the tissue cassettes in 30% EtOH for 30 minutes.
Incubate the tissue cassettes in 50% EtOH for 30 minutes.
Incubate the tissue cassettes in 70% EtOh for 20 minutes.
Store the tissue cassettes at 4°C until further processing.
Proceed with routine histological processing starting from dehydration at 70% EtOH.
Embed tissues in paraffin and section to a thickness of 4 μm.
Perform immunohistochemical or immunofluorescence staining on the sections.
Remove medium from organoids and wash with 1 mL PBS at 20°C–23°C.
Add 1 mL of 4% PFA solution (100 mM Sucrose) for 30 minutes at 20°C–23°C.
Wash the organoids twice with PBS at 20°C–23°C.
Transfer detached Matrigel and organoids to a 1.5 mL tube when detaching during washing steps.
Scrap off organoid/Matrigel layer using a 1000 μL pipette tip coated with 1% BSA/PBS.
Rinse the well again with PBS to transfer nearly all remaining organoids.
Centrifuge organoids at 200 × g for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant.
Add 1 mL of 25% sucrose solution in PBS.
Incubate for 14–18 hours at 4°C.
Transfer organoids from the tube to cryomolds using BSA/PBS-coated tips, minimizing excess liquid.
Add a layer of Tissue-Tek O.C.T. compound dropwise at opposite edges of the mold to avoid air bubbles and floating of organoids.
Aspirate remaining air bubbles with a 200 μL pipette.
Arrange organoids in the center if necessary using a needle.
Wait for around 5 minutes for Tissue-Tek O.C.T. to enter the tissue and air bubbles to vanish.
Snap-freeze samples in liquid nitrogen.
Store at -80°C.
Generate 6–10 μm thick sections on SuperFrost plus slides using a cryotome according to standard histological procedures.
